text:
maya.partnerships: Quick coordination thread — Snowflake DeltaShare connector + Qdrant vector adapter marketplace plan. Proposed announce window: Thu May 4 09:00 PT. Need final signoff items below, reply with :white_check_mark: on the thing you own.

maya.partnerships: TL;DR checklist:
- compatibility/perf tests (eng)
- marketplace assets (product/marketing)
- legal embargo & press copy (legal)
- SI handoff + integration docs (solutions)
- demo environment + runbook (ops)

raj.engineering: I can own compatibility/perf. Planning to run full shard-level perf with a 100M-vector sample by Tue. Will need a stable quantized model build and the schema mapping for DeltaShare.

maya.partnerships: @raj.engineering thanks — can you post the perf command and expected artifact location when you start?

raj.engineering: Yep. Running on staging-gpu1. Basic ingest command I'll use:
```
redwood ingest --connector snow-delta-share \
  --source s3://redwood-samples/delta-100m/ \
  --vector-db qdrant://staging-qdrant:6333 \
  --shards 8 \
  --quantize int8 \
  --output /artifacts/deltashare-100m-perf.tar.gz
```
I'll share logs and latency p95 numbers in this thread.

tomas.se: I can prep SI handoff doc + migration notes. Need to confirm the auth flow for external connectors (Snow->Redwood->Qdrant). Is the DeltaShare connector going to support cross-account read only roles?

maya.partnerships: Yes — initial plan supports cross-account read role + optional delegated creds. @tomas.se we'll attach the auth diagram to the SI doc.

lina.gtm: Marketing here — for marketplace listing we need: 1) short blurb, 2) 3 screenshot images (console + ingest + perf), 3) quick-start snippet, 4) logo SVG + 120x60 PNG. Deadline for assets: Wed EOD to hit Thu announce. Who can produce screenshots?

raj.engineering: I can dump a perf dashboard screenshot after tests complete.

tomas.se: I can capture the console onboarding flow screenshots from staging.

evan.legal: From legal — embargo window request noted. We need the final press blurb and partner logos by Wed 17:00 PT to review IP and co-marketing terms. Also confirm partner approval for using Snowflake and Qdrant logos in our marketplace tile.

maya.partnerships: Noted @evan.legal — I'll ping partners today for logo/approval and share legal contact.

ops-bot: [staging] demo environment created: staging-snowbridge-2026-05-01 (owner: tomas.se)

tomas.se: Demo runbook draft: start staging connector, run ingest (see @raj.command), validate vector counts, run nearest-neighbor query smoke test. I'll paste the smoke test query after ingest.

raj.engineering: Smoke test (post-ingest):
```
# verify counts
curl -s http://staging-qdrant:6333/collections/delta_vectors/points/count
# basic NN query
curl -X POST http://staging-qdrant:6333/collections/delta_vectors/points/search -d '{"vector": [0.1,0.2,...], "limit": 5}'
```
Should be quick to run.

lina.gtm: For the marketplace tile copy, draft suggestion: "Redwood + Snowflake DeltaShare connector: Directly serve vectors from your Delta tables into Qdrant-backed embeddings. Low-latency serving, predictable throughput, and one-click marketplace onboarding." Thoughts?

maya.partnerships: Lgtm, Lina — shorter version for marketplace headline: "DeltaShare connector for Snowflake + Qdrant — serve vectors with predictable latency."

evan.legal: Also flag: any customer logos or quotes in the listing need signed approval. If marketing wants to include partner quote, please attach signed permission.

raj.engineering: Quick note on compatibility: we found a schema edge where nested VARIANT->ARRAY columns map poorly to our vector extractor. I'll open a tiny PR to add a flatten/normalize step. If that lands by Mon morning, perf runs unaffected.

maya.partnerships: @raj.engineering please tag the PR and link here. If it slips, we push announce to Fri to avoid partner churn.

deploy-bot: Release candidate created: rc-connector-snow-delta-2026-05-02 (#2187) — tests pending

tomas.se: For the SI package, I'll include: architecture diagram, auth flow, troubleshooting matrix, sample terraform for role creation, sample SQL extraction & DeltaShare manifest template. Anyone want to add a runbook step?

lina.gtm: Add marketing checklist: product one-pager, FAQ, handout PDF for partner events, & demo script. I can draft the one-pager if I get the screenshots.

maya.partnerships: Action owners recap: 
- raj.engineering: perf + PR for flatten (due Mon EOD) :white_check_mark:
- tomas.se: SI doc + demo runbook + screenshots (due Wed AM) :white_check_mark:
- lina.gtm: marketplace copy, one-pager draft (due Wed EOD)
- evan.legal: embargo & logo clearance (review by Wed 17:00)
- ops-bot: confirm staging env + access (done)

maya.partnerships: If everyone is on track, I'll lock announce window Thu 09:00 PT and send partner/press invites Wed noon. If any item stalls, we move to Fri.

raj.engineering: Sharing first perf snapshot in ~3h.

tomas.se: Demo runbook pasted:
1) start connector: `connector start --name delta-share --env staging`
2) run ingest (see @raj.engineering command)
3) validate counts & run NN smoke test
4) hand off to SI: share terraform & role ARN

lina.gtm: Added a quick screenshot task to #design so we get polished assets.

maya.partnerships: Thanks team — tagging this thread as the single source of truth for the announce. Ping me if anything blocks.

deploy-bot: Tests completed for rc-connector-snow-delta-2026-05-02 — all green.

raj.engineering: Perf run complete: 100M vectors, 8 shards, int8 quantize — ingest throughput 22k vectors/s, p95 ingest latency 420ms, query p95 ~28ms. Uploading artifacts to /artifacts/deltashare-100m-perf.tar.gz

maya.partnerships: Awesome, thx @raj.engineering — Lina/tomas can you pull the dashboard screenshot and we should be good to go for Wed asset deadline.

lina.gtm: Got the perf dashboard screenshot. Evan, sending draft blurb + logos for legal review now.

evan.legal: Received. Reviewing, will ping if edits needed — expect feedback by 16:30 PT.

maya.partnerships: Great — locking announce Thu 09:00 PT unless we hear blockers. :rocket:
